scope: Cells at 70–80% confluency were lysed using boiling lysing buffer (5% SDS (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Vilnius, Lithuania), 0.1 M TRIS pH 8.5 (Thermo Scientific, Rockford, IL), 10 mM 2-CAA (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO) and 5 mM TCEP (Thermo Scientific, Rockford, IL) dissolved in LC/MS grade dH2O (Fischer chemical, Ottawa) and transferred into low protein binding tubes.
The lysates were then sonicated with a microtip for 2 min (1 s on/1 s off pulses, 50% amplitude) on ice.
PAC digestion (protein aggregation capture) of the lysates was performed with a mixture of LysC (1:500) and trypsin (1:250).
